content.text: Head: normal head contour, atraumatic, normocephalic, facial symmetry. no edema, erythema, or masses. no tenderness of scalp, facial structures, joints, and temporal artery on palpation. skull integrity intact. hair texture normal, full even distribution of hair, no masses, facial drooping, fasciculations, thickening of skin, scaling/dryness, bony protuberance. B/L TMJ has no tenderness on palpation, crepitus, or edema. B/L parotid gland is not tender on palpation, firm, or enlarged. B/L sub-mandibular gland is not tender on palpation, firm, or enlarged.

External: BL eyebrow normal size, distribution, shape, extends to outer canthus. BL orbital area has no edema, lesions, masses, redundant skin. BL eyelids are symmetric, have no ptosis, edema, erythema, masses, lesions, scaling, infestations, or fasciculations. BL lacrimal gland unremarkable. Conjunctiva and Sclera pink, no injections, discharge, edema, pterygium, scleral icterus, or FB. Cornea clear. Iris intact. PERRLA, BL 3mm in size. No photo-phobia. EOM intact, no nystagmus. Visual Acuity: Gross visual acuity intact. Using the tumbling E chart, OD, OS, OU: 20/20, no corrective lens used. BL Visual fields are full via confrontation. BL corneal reflex intact. Palpation: no tenderness, masses, lesions, crepitus, edema noted on eyelids, globes, and orbital bones. Fundoscopic exam: BL red reflex. Unremarkable disc-cup ratio. Disc well-defined and cream colored. No haemorrhages, exudates, AV nicking. Macula intact and yellow-free.

External: BL auricle aligned with outer cathus. Auricle, tragus, mastoid, lobule have no tenderness, erythema, edema, masses, or lesions. Internal: BL IAC has mild cerumen. BL IAC has no erythema, edema, discharge, FB, lesions, or masses. BL TM is translucent, pearly, intact, and convex. No effusion, retraction, scarring. BL TM is mobile with bony landmarks and cone of light visualized. Tests: Conversational hearing intact. BL unremarkable finger rub test. Weber lateralize BL. Rinne: AC>BC BL.

External: External inspection normal and symmetric. Skin appropriate color, no masses, lesions, edema, ecchymoses, or rashes. No tenderness of bone, cartilage on palpation. Frontal sinus', maxillary sinus', sphenoid sinus' non-tender when palpated and percussed. Transillumination normal. BL nare patency intact. Internal: Muscosa pink, moist and septum mid-line. No discharge, polyps, congestion, or FB.

External: Lips pink, intact, symmetric, well-defines. No edema, lesions, ecchymoses, or crust. Mouth: Normal bite. Good dentition, no missing teeth, no tenderness on palpation. Buccal mucosa pink and moist, no lesions. Gingiva pink and firm, no tenderness, lesions, or sores. Tongue is pink and mid-line, no edema or lesions. Parotid glad, submandibular gland, and sublingual glands are not tender, firm, or enlarged. Pharynx: Pharynx pink, moist, and clear. Soft palate pink and symmetric. Uvula midline with symmetric rise. BL Tonsils +1 without exudates. Gag reflex intact.
